title: Paperclip–OpenClaw Error Taxonomy
description: Exhaustive error code taxonomy for the Paperclip ↔ OpenClaw contract. Each code maps to a category, retryability, and handler behavior.

INVALID_REQUEST.description: Malformed envelope — missing required fields or wrong structure.

CONTRACT_VERSION_UNSUPPORTED.description: contractVersion is not accepted by this server.
CONTRACT_VERSION_UNSUPPORTED.handler: Return 400; client must upgrade contract version.

SCHEMA_VALIDATION_FAILED.description: params failed Zod validation against the registry schema.
SCHEMA_VALIDATION_FAILED.handler: Return 400 with validation error details; do not retry.

UNKNOWN_OPERATION.description: Operation not found in the registry.
UNKNOWN_OPERATION.handler: Return 403 Forbidden; operation is not allowed.

POLICY_DENIED.description: Operation is forbidden for the caller's package/lane.
POLICY_DENIED.handler: Return 403; details.required_package may indicate needed upgrade.

APPROVAL_REQUIRED.handler: Return 403; details.approval_class indicates required approval class. Block until approval is granted.

APPROVAL_DENIED.description: Approval was denied by the operator.
APPROVAL_DENIED.handler: Return 403; do not retry without new approval.

APPROVAL_TIMEOUT.description: Approval request expired or no route to approver.

IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT.description: Same idempotencyKey used with different request payload hash.

WORK_ITEM_NOT_FOUND.description: Referenced work item does not exist (404).

WORK_ITEM_BLOCKED.description: Work item has open blockers; cannot complete.
WORK_ITEM_BLOCKED.handler: Return 409 Conflict; resolve blockers before retry.

RATE_LIMITED.handler: Respect Retry-After header; retry up to configured max attempts.

TIMEOUT.handler: Retry with backoff if idempotency key present; otherwise fail.

UPSTREAM_UNAVAILABLE.handler: Retry with backoff [1000, 3000, 10000]ms; requires idempotency key.

UPSTREAM_FAILED.description: Known upstream failure that cannot be retried safely.

UNKNOWN_STATE.description: Mutation state is unclear (pending entry in unknown state).

UNKNOWN_ERROR.handler: Return 500; log for investigation; do not retry.
